reviews.text: The tint itself is long lasting. But be warned: you need to work quickly when applying it. If it’s not distributed fast and evenly, it clings to lip lines and creates patchy pigment spots. Also, be extremely careful with the packaging, the container breaks super easily if you drop it or knock it into something, making a total mess.
reviews.zh: 隻 tint 本身持久。但要留意：上妝時手腳要快。如果分佈得唔夠快唔夠均勻，佢會黐住唇紋，產生一撻撻嘅色斑。另外，包裝要超級小心，個容器跌一跌或者撞到嘢就好易爛，搞到一塌糊塗。

reviews.text: I think this is a nice product. I don’t think it lasts 12hrs fully but it does last long. The tint is super light but it’s a nice color. I would purchase more colors because I find it more hydrating than rom&nd and peripera(my two favorite brands). My lips are less chapped when wearing this and the glossiness lasts a long time.
reviews.zh: 我覺得呢件係好嘅產品。我唔覺得佢可以完整keep到 12 小時，但真係幾持久。隻 tint 好淡但係好靚。我會回購多啲色號，因為比起 rom&nd 同 peripera（我兩大愛牌）更加保濕。戴住佢嘅時候嘴唇冇咁爆拆，光澤感都好持久。

reviews.text: I really love AMUSE's Jel-Fit Tints! I bought this as a gift so I don't have a proper photo for this. I'm a Spring light tone and I've previously been using #01 Peach Jelly and #05 Oat Fig and love them so much that I decided to buy this #10 Cool Dive shade for my sister! It applies so smoothly and is very moisturizing! Just one swipe is sufficient to last me about half a day. The shades are very natural looking and its just perfect for a very light tint of lip colour. Will definitely be buying more shades from this series!
reviews.zh: 我真係超愛 AMUSE 嘅 Jel-Fit Tints！我買呢個係送禮，所以冇影到啱嘅相片。我係 Spring light tone，之前用緊 #01 Peach Jelly 同 #05 Oat Fig，鍾意到不得了，所以決定買呢個 #10 Cool Dive 色號畀阿妹！上色超順滑，超保濕！淨係掃一下就可以keep到差唔多半日。色號好自然，對於想要淡淡唇色嘅人嚟講簡直完美。一定會回購呢個系列更多色號！

reviews.text: I really love AMUSE's Jel-Fit Tints! I'm a Spring light tone and I've previously been using #01 Peach Jelly and #05 Oat Fig and love them so much that I decided to try this #10 Fig Jam shade also! It applies so smoothly and is very moisturizing! Just one swipe is sufficient to last me about half a day. The shades are very natural looking and its just perfect for a very light tint of lip colour. Will definitely be buying more shades from this series!
reviews.zh: 我真係超愛 AMUSE 嘅 Jel-Fit Tints！我係 Spring light tone，之前用緊 #01 Peach Jelly 同 #05 Oat Fig，鍾意到不得了，所以決定自己再試 #10 Fig Jam 色號！上色超順滑，超保濕！淨係掃一下就可以keep到差唔多半日。色號好自然，對於想要淡淡唇色嘅人嚟講簡直完美。一定會回購呢個系列更多色號！

reviews.text: Chubby and cute but honestly not that practical as I find it hard to store in my makeup containers and smaller bags. The colour is nice for cool skin tone but note it does seem to darken over time. Consistency for a lip tint is ok and leaves a stain but it also feels a bit drying after a while and not the most comfortable feeling on the lips.
reviews.zh: 圓碌碌好得意但老實講唔算實用，我覺得難以放入化妝箱同細袋入面。冷色肌用呢隻色幾靚，但要留意佢用耐咗好似會變深色。作為唇 tint 質地OK，會留底色，但用一陣之後會有少少乾，唔算係最舒服嘅唇上感覺。

reviews.text: I have several formulas from Amuse and love them. So, I had to pick the Jel-fit to try. Overall, they are great quality like most amuse products. The con I find is the dry down and color system. They have a unset jello consistency and go on pigmented. However, I find the color deepens quit a lot from the original shade. #06 Seoul girl is suppose to me a daily your lips but better mauve, the shade does on as advertised in pictures but darkens about 1-2 shades and leaves a red tint like those ole school first gen lip tints from like Etude or Tonymoly. They tint last about 3 hours but clings to dry spots. I like the application and feel of them so I will try a different shade
reviews.zh: 我有 Amuse 幾款配方嘅產品都好鍾意。所以一定要揀 Jel-fit 嚟試。整體質素好似大部分 Amuse 產品咁好。我發現嘅缺點係乾透過程同顏色系統。佢哋有未凝固嘅 jello 質地，上色好顯色。不過我發覺顏色比起原本色號深咗好多。#06 Seoul girl 聲稱係日日用、似自己唇色但更好嘅 mauve 色，隻色上嘴係好似相片咁，但會深 1-2 個色號，留低紅色 tint，好似以前第一代嘅唇 tint，例如 Etude 或者 Tonymoly 嗰啲。Tint 可以keep到大概 3 小時，但會黐住乾燥位。我鍾意佢哋嘅上色同觸感，所以會再試其他色號。

reviews.text:
The formula of this tint is really unique and there's nothing out there quite like it. The texture is interesting - it's thick like a serum. It isn't traditionally sticky, but has a sort of elastic feel to it when first applied. The gloss rises up after a minute or so and the texture then feels lighter and more watery.
The longevity is really great. It lasted me a 12 hr shift and only got a bit less glossy. It's also very moisturizing.
The one con is that it does very much exhibit the Yoplait effect so that needs to be wiped a little after applying.

Peach Jelly is a really pretty pinkish peach shade that is a little more muted IRL than in the pictures. 

Will definitely buy more shades!
reviews.zh:
呢隻 tint 嘅配方真係好獨特，市面上冇乜嘢似佢。質地好有趣——好似精華咁厚。佢唔係傳統嘅黐笠感，但剛搽上去嗰陣有種彈性嘅感覺。過咗一分鐘左右光澤會浮上嚟，質感會變得輕盈同水潤啲。
持久度真係一流。我上咗 12 小時嘅更，光澤只係減少咗少少。亦都好保濕。
唯一缺點係真係有 Yoplait 效應，所以搽完之後需要抹一抹。

Peach Jelly 係好靚嘅粉調蜜桃色，比起相片實際顏色再啞少少。

一定會回購多啲色號！

reviews.text: Absolutely love this product. I generally like glossy lip products more than matte ones due to my dry lips/lip line. This beautifully covers the dryness on my lips and is very comfortable to wear. It’s slightly sticky as expected for a wet/gloss type product but it’s not the kind of thick stickiness that is uncomfortable. I also love that it leaves a stain once the glossiness has worn off. I think I’ll be buying another shade soon!
reviews.zh: 勁鍾意呢件產品。因為我嘴唇／唇邊乾燥，一般我比較鍾意 glossy 唇妝多過霧面。佢完美地遮蓋咗我嘴唇嘅乾燥位，戴住好舒服。對濕潤／gloss 類產品嚟講係預期之中有少少黐笠，但唔係嗰種令人唔舒服嘅厚身黐笠感。我亦都好鍾意當光澤退咗之後會留低染唇色。諗緊好快會再買多隻色號！
